description: This file contains unit tests for the ChangeLogDetective class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing the handling of Liquibase change sets, including filtering certain change sets by filename, author, and ID, as well as testing the ordering of snapshot versions and logging behavior.

classes.name: ChangeLogDetectiveTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ChangeLogDetective, testing various methods and behaviors related to Liquibase change sets within the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: shouldGetSnapshotVersionsInDescendingOrder
methods.description: Tests that getSnapshotVersionsInDescendingOrder correctly sorts version strings in descending order.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreDisableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Tests that change sets with certain authors and IDs are recognized as vintage change sets to ignore.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreEnableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Tests that enabling foreign key checks is identified as a vintage change set to ignore.

methods.name: shouldNotIgnoreDisableForeignKeyChecksForFilenameOtherThanLiquibaseCoreData_1_9_x
methods.description: Ensures that change sets with similar IDs are not ignored if filename does not match the specified pattern.

methods.name: shouldNotIgnoreEnableForeignKeyChecksForFilenameOtherThanLiquibaseCoreData_1_9_x
methods.description: Ensures that change sets with similar IDs are not ignored if filename does not match the pattern.

methods.name: shouldNotIgnoreOtherChangeSetFromAuthorNamedBen
methods.description: Verifies that change sets authored by 'ben' but with different IDs are not recognized as vintage change sets to ignore.

methods.name: shouldExcludeVintageChangeSets
methods.description: Tests that the excludeVintageChangeSets method removes change sets with IDs related to foreign key check toggles when filename matches pattern.

methods.name: shouldNotExcludeChangeSetsForFilenameOtherThanLiquibaseCoreData_1_9_x
methods.description: Verifies that change sets are not excluded if filename does not match pattern.

methods.name: shouldLogSmallNumberOfUnrunChangeSets
methods.description: Checks that logUnRunChangeSetDetails returns true when change set count is below threshold.

methods.name: shouldNotLogLargeNumberOfUnrunChangeSets
methods.description: Checks that logUnRunChangeSetDetails returns false when change set count exceeds threshold.

methods.name: shouldNotLogUnrunChangeSetsFromOtherChangeLogFile
methods.description: Verifies that change sets from other files do not trigger logging.
